seo.title: I Do Fencing | Timber, Colorbond & Commercial Fencing
seo.description: Strong, straight fences built to last. Timber paling, Colorbond and commercial fencing with old fence removal and free, no-obligation quotes.

hero.heading: Strong, straight fences built to last.
hero.text: From timber paling boundaries to Colorbond and commercial jobs — we pull out the old, put in the new and leave the site clean.

items.title: Timber Paling
items.text: Classic treated-pine paling fences with plinths, lapped or butted, stepped or raked to suit sloping blocks.
items.alt: New timber paling fence with black pool gate

items.title: Colorbond
items.text: Low-maintenance steel fencing in a range of Colorbond colours — clean lines, privacy and no painting.
items.alt: Grey Colorbond fence beside a house

items.title: Commercial & Gates
items.text: Long runs for commercial and industrial sites, plus gates and pool-style fencing to finish the job.
items.alt: Long black steel fence on a commercial site

work.intro: Real jobs, straight off the tools.
